title: Security
description: How your sign-in to the platform is protected.
enabled: An authenticator app is linked to your account.
notEnabled: No authenticator app is linked yet.
howCode: There is no password. You sign in with your work email and the code from your authenticator app (Microsoft Authenticator or Google Authenticator), or with the Microsoft button.
howMicrosoft: Even when you sign in with Microsoft, the app code is asked every time.
howSessions: A session ends after 12 hours, and immediately if your account is deactivated.
lostBody: Use one of the backup codes you saved when you linked the app, or ask HR to reset the app so a new invitation reaches you.

sessions.title: Devices you are signed in on
sessions.description: Every open sign-in in your name. End any session you do not know.

trusted.title: Trusted devices
trusted.description: After signing in with Microsoft and entering the code, you can trust the browser so the code is not asked there for the days the platform administrator set. E-mail sign-in always asks for the code.
trusted.removed: The device is no longer trusted.
trusted.remember: Remember this device and do not ask for the code there

settings.trustedDeviceDaysHint: How long the code is skipped on a trusted browser after a Microsoft sign-in. 0 switches the choice off (at most {{max}}).
settings.requestsPerMinuteHint: How many requests one address may send a minute before it is told to wait. One page load sends dozens of requests, so a low value stops the whole platform (minimum 120, default 600). Sign-in has its own stricter limit.
settings.impersonationEnabled: Let platform administrators sign in as another employee
settings.impersonationEnabledHint: Off by default. When on, an administrator in admin mode can open any active employee's account from the employees list; the employee is told afterwards, and everything done is recorded under their name with the administrator's beside it.
settings.impersonationIdleMinutes: Minutes without activity before it ends
settings.impersonationIdleMinutesHint: A session of this kind ends by itself after this many minutes without a request.
settings.range: Enter a whole number between {{min}} and {{max}}.

domains.label: Allowed e-mail domains
domains.hint: One domain per line (like partner.org). An employee cannot be added with an address outside them. Left empty, only the default domain {{default}} is allowed.
